flows.title: Browse the records in a module
steps: In the sidebar, click the module you want, such as Deals.
The list view shows every record you have access to, as a table with columns for the key fields.
Use the view switcher at the top to change how they are laid out: List for scanning many at once, Kanban for cards arranged by stage, and Canvas where an admin has designed one.
Click any record to open its detail page, which holds its fields, the records related to it, the activity timeline, notes and attachments.

flows.title: Create a lead
steps: Click the + Quick Create button in the top bar and select + Lead, or open the Leads module and click Create Lead.
Fill in the fields it requires, Last Name and Company, and add whatever else you have, such as email, phone or lead source.
The new lead appears in the Leads module, and from its detail page you can add notes, schedule follow-up tasks or log calls.
